configuration.final_selection: last two-grid hard-cap eligible point with strictly decreasing true maximum eta
configuration.optimizer_objective: smooth true spectral metric excess then small normalized step; curvature is hard
configuration.SOC_correction_objective: box-width-normalized L1 norm inside a hard infinity radius
configuration.SOC_backtracking_path: x+alpha*p+(alpha/alpha0)^2*w; alpha0 is the actual corrected primary fraction
configuration.soft_goal_separation: target row below selected worst target slack, plus true eta peak pair

adaptive_scale_definition.primary_prediction: old selected rows plus J step
adaptive_scale_definition.SOC_prediction: same actual y selected rows plus J correction
adaptive_scale_definition.arc_prediction: declared parabolic basepoint linear bound; undefined ratio if no predicted drop

curvature_proposal_floor_definition.units: existing scale100 actual-metric PSD trace/determinant row units
curvature_proposal_floor_definition.primary_target: max(old half-current-margin target, floor), only groups7..10
curvature_proposal_floor_definition.SOC_target: max(old quarter-nonnegative-base-margin target, floor), only groups7..10

same_parameter_Pi_refinement.name: same spectral-metric-recovery state and fixed hard cap; original angular grids

curvature_proposal_floor.units: existing scale100 actual-metric PSD trace/determinant row units
curvature_proposal_floor.primary_target: max(old half-current-margin target, floor), only groups7..10
